messages:
raj-support: Heads-up — AcmeShop reporting flickering embedding vector lengths across envs after the router roll. Hosted returns 1536 dims, Dedicated/Private return 1024. Started ~09:00 UTC. Search ranking broken for them. Can we triage?

maria-eng: Can you paste a minimal repro (curl) and the exact model name + any request ids?

raj-support: Repro snippets below (sanitized keys):
```bash
# hosted
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"text-embed-large-v2","input":["product description here"]}'
# response: vector length 1536 (len(vec)=1536)

# dedicated
curl -X POST https://dedicated-acme.redwood.internal/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"text-embed-large-v2","input":["product description here"]}'
# response: vector length 1024 (len(vec)=1024)
```
Also tried private with same key -> 1024. Request-IDs: hosted=0xabc123, dedicated=0xdef456.

liam-ml: That smells like variant/quantization mismatch (fp16 vs q4int8) or wrong checkpoint on served nodes. Check response headers for X-Model-Variant / X-Model-Checksum and the model manifest's embedding_size.

raj-support: Copied response headers:
- hosted: X-Model-Variant: text-embed-large-v2.fp16; X-Model-Checksum: sha256:aaa111
- dedicated: X-Model-Variant: text-embed-large-v2.int8; X-Model-Checksum: sha256:bbb222

maria-eng: We need eng-runtime logs from the affected dedicated pods (model_loader and kernel selection), plus smart-router mapping. Also confirm whether the batching layer changed: look for header X-Batch-Config or logs with "continuous-batching".

olivia-ops: Noted — we rolled a smart-router config yesterday to prefer the "compact" variant on dedicated pools for cost savings (canary). The rollback was partial; looks like some dedicated nodes still had the compact mapping. Investigating which nodes.

sarah-billing: Customer also reports an unexpected invoice spike (INV-2026-0457). They reprocessed some requests client-side due to wrong dims. I'm CC'ing billing.

raj-support: Quick repro plan I ran: 1) call hosted -> 1536; 2) call dedicated -> 1024; 3) call private -> 1024. Client observed degraded search relevance. I pushed the request-ids above to logs.

liam-ml: Actionable checks: 1) confirm model manifest embedding_size == 1536 for text-embed-large-v2; 2) verify model image/checksum on dedicated pool matches hosted; 3) check quantization config file (qconfig.json) presence. If checksum differs, the router alias mapping likely pointed to a different artifact.

maria-eng: eng-runtime: please share `kubectl logs` for model-loader and the kernel-selection trace for the two request-ids. Also show the smart-router exact mapping for AcmeShop (tenant override).

deploy-bot: deploy: smart-router canary roll sr-2026-78 -> partial (applied to dedicated-pool-b) at 2026-03-16T22:30:12Z by olivia-ops

olivia-ops: I'm performing a targeted rollback to dedicated-pool-b now. Will mark nodes draining and redeploy correct mapping. ETA ~30m.

raj-support: Please confirm before I ask customer to re-run tests. They want a mitigation ASAP (can we force-route them to hosted until fixed?).

maria-eng: Temporary mitigation: we can add a routing override so AcmeShop traffic goes to hosted embeddings. I'll stage the policy change and push it (no infra downtime).

liam-ml: Longer-term: add a parity monitor in the Optimize pipeline that takes a small set of canonical prompts and ensures embedding dims and sample cosine similarity across hosted/dedicated/private every 5m. Also add CI guard to check alias->artifact checksum equality on rollout.

sarah-billing: Billing: provisional credit created for AcmeShop (BX-9876). We'll hold reconciliation pending RCA.

raj-support: Thanks. Next steps: eng-runtime to gather logs + manifest, ops to finish rollback, product/devex to add temporary routing override, ML to add parity monitor. Postmortem + PR to add schema guard requiring embedding_size in manifest.

olivia-ops: Rollback completed on dedicated-pool-b at 2026-03-17T01:12:03Z. Verified model checksum now matches hosted (sha256:aaa111).

raj-support: Re-tested: dedicated now returns 1536 for request-id 0xdef456. Customer confirmed search recovered. Closing after postmortem.

maria-eng: I'll own the postmortem and follow-up PRs. Will include timeline, root cause (router mapping leak to compact variant), and mitigations.

raj-support: :thumbsup: closing after postmortem lands. Keep thread for follow-up items.
